spring-force.def: The force a stretched or compressed spring exerts on an object attached to its end, always toward the spring's relaxed length: a stretched spring pulls, a compressed spring pushes.

hookes-law.def: For an ideal spring, F_s = −kΔx: the spring force is proportional to the displacement Δx of its end from the relaxed length, and opposite to it. The spring constant k (N/m) measures stiffness.

ideal-spring.def: A model spring that has no mass and obeys Hooke's law exactly, so it exerts forces of equal size at its two ends.
